description: Source code for the FieldLabel class and related GUI dialog components in the MenuLibre project, handling label display and info dialogs with GTK.

classes.name: FieldLabel
classes.description: A GTK widget class for displaying a label with an info button that shows additional information.

classes.name: FieldInfo
classes.description: A GTK message dialog class that displays detailed information about a field, including optional help URL.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for FieldLabel, initializes label, icon, and tooltip, and connects button click to callback.

methods.name: _button_clicked_cb
methods.description: Callback for info button click, creates and shows a FieldInfo dialog.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for FieldInfo, sets up the message dialog with primary and secondary text, and optional help button.

methods.name: response_cb
methods.description: Handles dialog responses; opens help URL if help button clicked, otherwise destroys dialog.
